summary: Disable Nagle buffering on peer sockets for interactive raw PTY replies

replay.detail: No claim or replay behavior changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet authority changes.

compatibility.detail: The peer wire protocol and raw PEEK/ATTACH authorization are unchanged; TCP sockets send small interactive frames without waiting for delayed ACKs.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond a normal daemon upgrade.

manual.detail: No configuration or migration steps required.
